The first version you can download.

**Install:** download `Nova-Stats.dmg`, open it and drag Nova Stats into Applications.
The first time, macOS says it can't check the app, because it isn't signed with a paid
Apple developer account. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and press
**Open Anyway**. You only do this once.

What's in it:

- Dashboard with CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery and sensors tabs, over Nova's 3D starfield
- Menu bar numbers you pick, with an optional mini CPU graph, and a quick panel
- A HUD over every app with no box behind it, in any corner
- Four desktop widgets
- Battery health, charge cycles, time left, and how many watts the whole Mac uses
- Every connected drive, with an Eject button
- The apps using the most memory or CPU
- Shortcuts from any app: ⌃⌥N for the dashboard, ⌃⌥H for the HUD
- Alerts when the Mac runs hot, memory gets tight or the disk is almost full
- °C or °F

Needs macOS 15 or newer. Made for Apple Silicon.
